text: Artificial intelligence is changing the workplace in many ways. One important change is automation. Machines can now do repetitive tasks, such as sorting data or answering simple customer questions. This saves time and reduces mistakes. AI also offers useful productivity tools, like smart calendars and writing assistants, which help employees work faster. In many jobs, human-AI collaboration is becoming normal. People focus on creative and social tasks, while AI handles boring or difficult work. However, these changes also affect jobs. Some roles may disappear, while new ones appear. Workers need to learn new skills to stay competitive and adapt to this fast-moving environment.
